feed.title: JOUNG LAB
feed.subtitle: We are a biomedical informatics lab at CHA University, integrating multi-omics data and machine learning to decode molecular heterogeneity in cancer and stem cells, and translating these insights into biomarkers for precision medicine and cell therapy.
